title: AZD9291 Versus Gefitinib or Erlotinib in Patients With Locally Advanced or Metastatic Non-small Cell Lung Cancer
conditions: Locally Advanced or Metastatic EGFR Sensitising Mutation Positive Non Small Cell Lung Cancer
brief_summary: To assess the efficacy and safety of AZD9291 versus a standard of care epidermal growth factor receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitor in patients with locally advanced or Metastatic Non Small Cell Lung Cancer
